sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Played out on a game-board arena of color-coded tiles rather than open ground — most of the difficulty here is floor management, not boss attacks. 6-minute enrage.

sections.heading: The three pillars
bullets: Three pillars around the arena grant special action skills: Dispel (strips orange shields, including off Jade Scouts), Claim (converts an enemy tile back to safe), and Protect (a 5-second invulnerability bubble, 180-second cooldown).
The Protect bubble is the only way to survive the spike-floor mechanic below — someone needs to hold it in reserve rather than using it early.
Mursaat Overseer fixates on whoever is currently holding the Claim skill, which affects positioning more than you'd expect.

sections.heading: Jade Scouts & Soldiers
bullets: Jade Scouts walk across the board — if they reach the far side, they become mobile Jade Soldiers that fixate on whoever holds Protect.

Soldiers flip safe tiles into <mark>Enemy Tile</mark> as they travel and pulse an aura that damages players, applies conditions, and empowers the boss (more aura damage, more damage from enemy-claimed tiles). Dispel their shield and cleave them down before they convert — letting multiple Soldiers stack up makes the fight noticeably worse.

sections.heading: The tiles
bullets: <mark>Enemy Tile</mark>: roughly 3,500 damage per second plus the Claimed condition — don't stand on one. Use Claim to convert it back when you can.

Green tiles turn blue-green, then spawn spikes that instantly kill anyone standing there — the only way to survive standing on one is the Protect bubble, so get off before it triggers if you don't have it up.
Spike/tile changes follow a set pattern rather than being random — track it instead of reacting late.

sections.heading: Punishment Aura
bullets: <mark>Punishment Aura</mark> pulses magical damage to everyone every 3 seconds for the entire fight — a steady healing/sustain check on top of the floor management.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 6:00 — past this point players can no longer use Claim, which snowballs the floor hazards fast.

cmSections.heading: What's different in Challenge Mote
bullets: The boss gains ~36% more health (22M → 30M), and Jade Soldiers nearly double their own health too — expect a much longer floor-management grind.

New mechanic: 4 tiles turn blue at intervals (starting around 5:33 remaining, every 30s, lasting 3s) — you must be standing on a blue tile when it detonates or you die instantly. The Protect bubble does not save you from this, unlike every other floor hazard.
Each player gets their own client-side set of blue tiles from one of four rotating patterns, so don't assume your tiles match your neighbor's.

The hard part is timing overlap between Blue detonations and the normal spike tiles — the Claim holder needs to keep the four center tiles safe at all times, sometimes forcing a Protect bubble placement just to survive the overlap.
